features: Versioned development installers for Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon and macOS Intel.
fixes: Whitespace-only and padded searches now use consistent matching and empty-result messages.
limitations: Unsigned development preview. macOS builds are not notarized and operating-system security checks may block launch.
Native macOS first-launch and installer lifecycle testing remain pending. Image validation does not certify application behavior.
Git is required for repository inspection. No automatic updater is provided.
Third-party dependency notice review remains incomplete; this preview is not stable release approval.
